errors.text: The proposed W-V-Ta-Ti-Cr laser-cladded coating does not reconstruct the MgAlTiVFeCo powder alloy sintered by SPS at 1000 °C.
A W- and Ta-rich refractory alloy is inconsistent with the requested lightweight-alloy emphasis, and no relative-density result is supplied.
The asserted 1500–2000 °C processing window and CrTaO4-specific protection mechanism are not established by the cited excerpts.
